sample.title: How Meta Will Enforce New Age And Time Limits On Instagram And Facebook
sample.description:
Meta has agreed to pay up to $17 billion and make sweeping changes to Instagram and Facebook as part of a landmark child safety settlement with nearly every U.S. state. The deal introduces new protections for teens, including time limits, overnight blocks and stronger age verification, changes that could fundamentally alter how young people use Meta’s platforms. But implementing those safeguards, particularly determining users’ ages, presents major technical and business challenges. CNBC’s Julia Boorstin examines how Meta plans to pull it off, and why the settlement could ultimately force changes across TikTok, YouTube and the rest of the social media industry.

sample.title: A20 Pro is Apple’s first 2nm iPhone chip, touting better heat control and on-device AI
sample.description: Apple just unveiled its A20 Pro system on a chip for its new folding iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro line, plus the C2 modem, which will help them connect to 5G. Apple’s new A20 Pro is the first high-volume smartphone processor to be made on TSMC 2 nanometer — its most advanced node, only made in Taiwan. The C2 is the second generation modem Apple has made in-house, in a move that further reduces reliance on cellular modem leader Qualcomm. CNBC's Katie Tarasov has the story.

Apple unveils new £1,999 foldable iPhone | BBC News
sample.description:
It’s almost 20 years since the first iPhone was released and since then more than three billion have sold worldwide, and Apple has now unveiled its first ever foldable iPhone. 
 
With a book-style format, the new iPhone, dubbed the Duo, is the largest ever size of the product. And with a US starting price of $1,999 (£1,475) going up to $3,200, it is also the most expensive. UK prices start at £1,999.
 
Apple's new chief executive John Ternus said the Duo was "inspired by the iPad" but called the folding features "fluid and completely intuitive."
